meta.title: About Viesigners — The BG Twins, UX/UI and CRO experts
meta.description: Viesigners is a Canadian web micro-agency founded by Charles-Erick and Jean-François BG: 30+ combined years in UX/UI and conversion rate optimization.

sections.lead: We are hybrid experts in web experience design, UX/UI and conversion rate optimization (CRO) — originally from Québec, Canada — with more than 30 combined years helping companies perform online.

brief.t: Charles-Erick and Jean-François BG, founders of Viesigners.
UX/UI, CRO, websites, landing pages and SaaS and app product design.
Québec and Vancouver, Canada — French- and English-speaking markets.
top 3% of the world's web experts (Toptal); projects recognized by Awwwards, OCTAS, Osentreprendre and Gartner.

sections.text: A unique approach that unites *customer experience* and *web business strategy.*
prose: Surrounded by a network of select digital experts, as human as they are skilled, we act as business advisors, strategic consultants, senior freelancers and delivery partners in designing offers and digital experiences.
We're a micro-agency by choice: you work directly with the experts, not with an inexperienced employee, and never feel like a number.

sections.lead: Two brothers, one obsession: reducing the friction between a quality offer and the people who need it.

sections.p: Tell us where you are; we'll honestly tell you whether we can help.

a: Charles-Erick and Jean-François BG are the founders of Viesigners. They are hybrid experts in UX/UI and CRO, originally from Québec, with more than 30 years of combined experience.
Viesigners has offices in Québec and Vancouver, Canada, and collaborates remotely with clients in more than 6 countries.
Because you work directly with the experts, with no inexperienced go-between, and all the energy is focused on your return on investment.

faq.q: Who do you work with besides the founding team?
a: A limited network of selected experts in digital advertising, social media and SEO/GEO, whom we bring into your project as needed.
